Subject: spill at Burnaby station
Got a call 0800 today from the day crew at Burnaby station. Looks like a line was cracked
open during some tie-in work-no idea whose call it was, but the valve wasn't
double-checked like the SOP says. Sweet crude hit the gravel pad inside the fence.
One guy says maybe 0.8 m³, another thinks closer to 3. No meter read yet, so we'll have to
wait for the vac truck numbers. Crew's got it contained on the pad, no runoff outside the
fence.
Need someone from compliance to give them the cleanup checklist-crew's still on site.
Marta
Control-room operator, Prairie Midstream Ltd.
